singleChangedCondition: Replace two of four RP full genuine-target windows with native modern-prose windows; source representation and changed body/EOS/role frequencies are measured consequences of this data condition

candidateDoseNotYetFrozen.blockingEndingCoverageIssue: Dropping partial final windows excludes true prose document EOS except lengths congruent1mod256. candidateDoseNotYetFrozen.reason: Matching body and all-target totals simultaneously would generally require changing masks or structural-token distribution. Primary dose is all genuine targets; body/EOS/role dose is reported separately.

framing.rp: original BOS, human A/B roles, original utterance bodies and EOS
framing.prose: BOS, original derived article body with declared paragraph join, EOS only at true article end

samplerToFreeze.policy: Precompute schedule from fixed final TRAIN pools; same common RP slots and deterministic source-order rule. Preserve old sampler state as provenance and save explicit new-stage source sampler states/schedule cursor.
samplerToFreeze.torchRng: Same inherited state and equal tensor shapes consume identical dropout-mask draws per update

checkpointSelection: terminal at fixed dose only; not best NLL, no generation-selected or post-hoc condition adjustment
